product.olivetti-prodest-pc128.summary: The Thomson home Prodest with a built-in cassette deck and two BASICs in ROM.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128.history: Olivetti Prodest documented the PC 128 in 1986 for the Italian home market. It was a Thomson-built adaptation of the MO6, with a QWERTY keyboard and UHF PAL output. It opened the Prodest home range, later joined by the Acorn-derived PC 128 S.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128.architect: The manual describes two resident BASICs for programs from different generations. The 64 KB ROM contains BASIC 128 and BASIC 1.0. MAME identifies pro128.iw01 and basico.iw02, each 32 KiB.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128.verified: The manual was checked against the MAME pro128 definition. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128.limitatio: ROM verification and functional tests are pending.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128.manual: Olivetti Prodest, PC 128 Manuale per l’utente, 1986, pp. 15–17.
